proof_availability.classification_scope: Actual retained syndrome cuts permit per-segment Pauli-word kernel tests and a common-decoder good CP subchannel, even when the union of segment footprints supports a logical. Exact four-qubit witnesses distinguish endpoint-good, history-good and absent-cut maps. Native completed-pair records are not full syndrome cuts; arbitrary faults on full check data footprint cannot satisfy the unchanged zero-good-support rule except on a fixed stabilizer factor. No virtual cut, probability majorant or generator relabeling closes the native memory gate.
